notes.title: v1.11
notes.notes:
Improved casting slash beam experience
- Fixed slash beam immediately casting upon touching first node, happens often.

- It will now be easier to cancel diagonal, vertical, horizontal slash beam casting. Do it by moving the greatsword out of the nodes path.

It should be easier to spam horizontal slash beams now in this update.

notes.title: v1.08 - Fixed 'null' error for slash beam.
notes.notes:
Fixed 'null' error when casting slash beams at more than visual 0.99 value.
Fixed 'Screen Resolution Ratio' missing in Gameplay Settings for Android only.
Fixed target FPS for Android, 'No Limit' or value more than 60, will be set to 60 fps.

notes.title: v1.07 - Slash Beams are now easier to cast
notes.notes:
- Removed Slash Beam fail mechanic.
- Can still cancel Slash Beam casting by tracing backwards or just moving greatsword to face backwards.
- Slash Beams commands now has 2 nodes instead of 3.
- Will now cast Slash Beam upon the greatsword exiting the final node, while the visual slash beam fill value is > 75%.
- Will now cast Slash Beam upon visual slash beam fill value > 99%.

notes.title: v1.06
notes.notes:
Updated in-game cursor to have white outline. Better contrast to see where your cursor is.

I believe this is the final small update.

notes.title: v1.05
notes.notes:
Added "Lock X Axis", "Lock Y Axis" Quality of life controls.
In Settings, 'Controls' ui has been updated.

Fixed keybind string displayed in tutorial/training may be the default keybind.

notes.title: v1.04
notes.notes: Added tutorial for Level 1, Greatsword Movement, to teach new players where they should place their mouse for better control over the greatsword.

notes.title: v1.03
notes.notes: Fixed error 409 when registering an email account. PlayFab account.

notes.title: v1.02
notes.notes: In Settings, Fixed 'Not in Gameplay FPS' dropdown. It was being assigned 'Gameplay FPS' dropdown value.

notes.title: Greatsword Point! Will be released now!
notes.notes:
This game is originally an endless waves game but expanded to have campaign and endless levels.
Action, Arcade, Hack & Slash.


After testing the game for hours, it seems that it does not have any major bugs I could find. Maybe it is just me.

I will be releasing the game early, since I was able to clear the game till endgame without any major bugs. And I probably will not be able to find anymore bugs myself.

Please try out this game if you feel like it. There is also Android version of this game in Google Play Store.

The whole point of this game is for the player to feel powerful, at least in the campaign, and able to fend off every enemy encountered.

The entire campaign should be around 30 minutes, and the endgame content should be another 30 minutes.



If the game has reception, I will consider updating it more. Else I will work into new games.

notes.title: Game should be releasing in May 2025
notes.notes:
Working hard to make content/cosmetic update for the game that can be played in both Android and Steam. It will be about equipment, where the player can equip/purchase different parts of the greatsword for appearance, as well as purchasable and equippable permanent upgrades/modifiers.

I will also make magic ingots more easily obtainable in normal gameplay, as there are finally more things to purchase.

Steam Version of the game should be releasing in May 2025, unless delayed by unpredictable reasons.
